main.description: Approve a membership application at a tier. Caller must be a current admin in the roster. Writes the grant to the registry space, authored by the calling admin. Re-approving with a different tier is how a tier change is recorded: it writes a fresh grant, and latest-event-wins resolves it.

tier.description: The tier slug to record on the grant: level-0 through level-9. Required — see the grant lexicon for why an absent tier is a fail-open bug rather than a harmless default.
